templates.name: utility_interpolation_image_upscale
templates.title: Image Upscale: Traditional Interpolation
templates.description: Upload an image and select an interpolation method. Upscale the image using traditional algorithms for faster processing with minimal detail changes.

templates.name: utility_bria_increase_resolution
templates.title: Image Upscale: Bria Increase Resolution
templates.description: Upscale any image to higher resolutions using Bria's dedicated resolution enhancement API, which preserves original content without adding new details or regenerating the image. The workflow accepts a single input image and produces one enhanced, higher-resolution output, supporting JPEG and PNG files in RGB, RGBA, or CMYK color modes up to a maximum area of 8192x8192 pixels. Built-in content moderation scans both the input image and generated output to ensure safe, policy-compliant processing. Ideal for preparing images for print, enlarging photos for digital display, or increasing resolution of assets for professional design work.
